steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: (Gasping heavily)

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Chill, Tippi, chill... deep breaths. Remember how the plot went in that movie—

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: ...The heroine had her friend pick up a weapon and hide in a storage room to the left, while she herself ran the other way...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Storage room...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Alright, the route matches up!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Down we go... It's kinda dark in here... Well, dark is good... There should be a hidden door around the corner...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Straight ahead, and at the end of the corridor there should be a backup control cabin...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: ...She knew all the mannequins chasing down the squad were her friend's work. The whole squad pointed their fingers at her friend, and she was mad too...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Gotta get moving!

steps.name: Panicking Staff
steps.text: What are you doing here, Tippi?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I figured out how to change the plate's trajectory! We can avoid any more casualties, so let me through ASAP!

steps.name: Panicking Staff
steps.text: There's a way out of this...?

steps.name: Skeptical Staff
steps.text: Don't listen to her lies! Isn't she the culprit's best friend?!

steps.name: Skeptical Staff
steps.text: She could've been covering up for her this whole time! How else could we have missed all this happening right under our noses, right up until we're about to die?!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: She tries not to think about her friend's betrayal, even though she still has things to say...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: She ignores the crowd mocking her. They're only attacking her to protect themselves...

steps.name: Panicking Staff
steps.text: It... it was you, the one always hiding in the back! First you interrupt the shooting, now you're preventing us from going home!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: She wants to save everyone, including her friend. She wants answers...

steps.name: Skeptical Staff
steps.text: Stop her! Don't let her through!

steps.name: Panicking Staff
steps.text: Agh, my eyes—!
Tippi grabs the spray-gun from her belt and glares at the fearsome weapon-wielding crew.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: You leave me no other choice...

steps.name: Skeptical Staff
steps.text: Are you guys afraid of one girl? Get her!
The murders, the Catastrophe... The film crew was already on-edge from having to hide in the engine layer, so the spray-painter's behavior only rouses their pent-up anger.
Their self-defense weapons scrape the floor as everyone rushes towards Tippi.
Her hands are trembling. There is no way she can take them all alone, and she prays the hover unit on her back will work...
Her final trump card.
A black creature shows up at the corner of the corridor.
It is as if the noise drew her here, but also as if she is merely passing by.
No one notices her as they rush by, their heads filled with all sorts of extreme emotions.
Miss.Christine takes a sniff, and the rushing crowd slows down in her eyes... until they freeze in place.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Anger. Extremely spicy, but without a little sour envy to balance it out, it tastes a bit off...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Panic. Bitter and hard to keep down, but a little dash of sweet comfort will turn it into a nice dessert...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Grief. A salty mix of tears and sighs that brings unnecessary trouble if too much is added. Must be carefully paired with other flavors...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Pain. The most complex and ever-changing emotion. It used to be my favorite...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: But after meeting Lucian, the pain of ordinary people is almost flavorless to me.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Well, there's another one over there... She seems to be that little Zalak's friend.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: At first I only took notice of that girl who seemed so similar to Lucian, the lead actress that man chose for his latest play. Yet I didn't expect your ties to make you even tastier than her.
Miss.Christine shakes her tails, her eyes moving between shadows on the ground until they lock onto Tippi's silhouette...
The lady's twin tails twist into strange shapes, as if a woman is wiping her knife and fork before diving into her meal.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Shakes tails)

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Licks paws after a meal)

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: ...I ought to gift you a small reward.
The lady glances at the crowd rushing towards the Liberi.
A little exercise to aid digestion after her meal, she thinks.

steps.name: Confused Staff A
steps.text: ...Why... am I here...?

steps.name: Confused Staff B
steps.text: The Catastrophe's about to hit us, so we came down here to hide from it... But what's with the wrench in my hand?
*thunk*—
Weapons fall from their hands in succession, as the resulting harsh clangs wake even more from their delirium.
They exchange looks of confusion, not knowing why they were all holding weapons, though they do know that they should leave.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow—

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Miss.Christine...? What're you doing here?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: How come they're leaving?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: When they were rushing towards me, I suddenly felt my whole body go cold, and lots of different feelings woke up in me at the same time. Like they were fighting...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But then a breeze blew by, I heard their weapons drop, and my body thawed out too.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Like some kinda irresistible force pulled something out of me...
Miss.Christine tilts her head.
She taps her tails twice on the floor, successfully attracting the girl's attention, then points in a direction.
...They are right in front of the control cabin.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: *cough* *cough* This place is older than I thought it'd be...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Wow, the devices here are all previous gen stuff...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But that's good news for us, since they're all sealed off to prevent dust and corrosion, and there's no smart locks on anything...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Even I'd find it pretty tough to learn to hack on the spot.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Lemme see...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: The storm's moving faster than the plate, so just reversing's a no-go. Turning—turning's the best way out.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But trying to change direction when the plate's already so close to the Catastrophe... No, I can't worry about that!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Where's the backup navigational system...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Here it is!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: First open the lock... Great, I'm in.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Then...
Tippi takes a deep breath, and hopes she remembers the steps right.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Pull the lever all the way down!
Bang—
Tippi is thrown against a wall by a huge force. The entire engine layer shakes, with all sorts of strange mechanical noises ringing throughout the tiny space—
That was the plate's 'waist' jerking around, with every segment of the treads below now trying to respond to the change.
The steel giant under her feet is now fighting its own immense and unstoppable inertia by steering sideways, trying to avoid the storm right up ahead—
Tippi feels her teeth ache.
She does not know if it will manage to turn in time, or how long it will take.
All she can do is pray.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Even a little shift will do. We'll have a tiny, tiny chance as long as we don't hit the storm's core.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: It has to work, it HAS to work!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I have to... see her one more time.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow—
Miss.Christine shakes her tails, jumping in front of the little Liberi to smell the changes in her mood.
A brief relief after achieving her goal, along with confusion and pain from a friend's betrayal... But why is there also a hint of suppressed madness?
No. That smell does not belong to the girl.
Miss.Christine jerks her head up, looking towards a place she cannot see. A companion who has been with her the whole time.
Lucian feels sympathy towards the other person, which means he is currently experiencing twice the pain.
Miss.Christine is somewhat displeased.
She cannot help but recall the night when the Crimson Troupe was destroyed, as Lucian sang under name Blood Diamond—
It is no good omen.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: How are you so calm, Lucian?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Are you disappointed? Unmoved by what I've done?
A mannequin pounces on him. While it is an inanimate object, Lucian feels a strong depressive aura that suddenly turns into elation and ecstasy...
As Lucian touches the mannequin, the emotions turn into energy, forcing him backwards.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...Dalton.
There is no doubt these are the feelings Dalton had right before his final rehearsal.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Why don't you fight back? Do you have that little interest in me, babe?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: But ever since you played the part of the Messenger and spoke those lines about fate, I haven't been able to take my eyes off you!

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...Michael.
The mannequin passes on Moira's emotions and she turns into Michael. The excessive yet artificial man who always wore his heart on his sleeve.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: What kind of emotions are you hiding inside yourself?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: You let me feel fear, and danger, so much danger...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...Shelly.
Shelly. In the final moments of her life, the neurotic coordinator was completely wrecked by her own fear.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Turning emotions into tangible energy, and any object that passes through your hands becomes a medium to release it...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...So these are your Originium Arts.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I see why he chose you. Why he led you to become what you are now.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: A prop master, strings, puppets... all images born just for the stage. When you forget your self, a person becomes a play.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Come, join in our performance, Lucian.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: If you're right, and that man roused my abilities, then as his real student, you will make the best dance partner!
Moira laughs and cries loudly... a thousand expressions flash across her face, filling the prop room with a suffocating energy—
There is nowhere for Lucian to run.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Moira, I will sing for you... as you wish.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The Blood Diamond's song is a kind of misfortune, for both himself and the audience.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: It will rip my throat apart, sending pain straight into your ears... And you will either die, or spend the rest of your life with its melody reverberating in your mind.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: If you willingly ignore the truth in your hands, if you're satisfied by such falsehoods, if you can only approach him by destroying yourself...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Then allow me to relieve your pain, and enter the stage once more.
Moira hears a song.
The emotions within flood into her, overwhelming even the song itself. She does not understand what Lucian is singing about, she only feels...
Joy, fear, doubt, rage, hatred, and sorrow—a hundred times stronger than her own...
Before she is completely washed away by the emotions, she cannot help but think—
What sort of experiences must one go through to understand such revelations—or was he simply forced to learn it all within the despair of having nothing at all—

steps.name: Troupe Member A
steps.text: Troupe Leader, Whiteflower is still waiting for us for the curtain call. Why have we come here?

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: This is just a river... There's nothing here this time of night...

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: I'm afraid Whiteflower will be upset by tonight's sparse audience.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: For this river here is the final stage.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Tell them, Playwright. What does the revised ending look like?

steps.name: Playwright
steps.text: The 'magician's assistant' and the 'lucky audience member' who both died on stage are stuffed into prop boxes and thrown into the river. Once the dust settles, they will wake up and emerge from the river under the stars...

steps.name: Playwright
steps.text: They used their story deaths to distance themselves from their prison of nightmares.

steps.name: Troupe Member A
steps.text: That's... Blood Diamond and Abyss?

steps.name: Troupe Member A
steps.text: Wait, didn't they return to the castle already? Why would they be here...

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: Are they... running away?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: It seems our travel plans have been interrupted, Abyss.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: What... how?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The 'magician's assistant' and 'lucky audience member' came back to life... now this is true magic.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: With this crowd looking on, it would seem he's a fan of this new improvised ending.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Let's go back, he's waiting for us.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Go back?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: We can still run, Lucian.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Come with me. The river's wide enough, and he's far enough away...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: If you choose to flee now, he'll let you go. But fear will seep into your bones, and torment you for the rest of your life.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I'll go back to him, learn all his skills, uncover all his secrets, and then destroy it all.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: For such is my wretched fate.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Fate? Are you sure it's not just proof that you've become entranced with the Troupe, with him, once more?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: If this is the pain and despair he has given me...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Then I will become his fate.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Somehow, you always understand him and his twisted aesthetics.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Yet you never listen to me... or maybe you never really wanted to escape. You've spent far too long trapped in this nightmare.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Fine then. I hope the Crimson Troupe's Blood Diamond will grant a former 'friend' one last favor—

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Don't chase me. Don't come after me.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Let us part here, friend... We will meet again once this all falls to ruin.
At some point, the black creature appears inside the prop room, nimbly avoiding Moira's body as she goes over to Lucian.
With his knees bent halfway, and surrounded by mannequin parts scattered all over the ground, for once, Lucian doesn't perform the gesture of a proper gentleman's salute to her.
The lady is even more displeased by his actions.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: You haven't sung in a long time, Lucian.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Apologies, Miss.Christine. Did you hurry here as soon as you could?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Flicks tails without comment)

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: What a terrible scent. This Zalak compelled you to use your Arts, as well as the skills you were so determined to abandon.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: You do know what sort of situation you've put yourself into, yes?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Chaotic, disorderly, uncontrollable... like a ball of unruly yarn I've yet to sort out.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: And you wish to face him, even end him, as you are now?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...That is why I've come here, Miss.Christine.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: When I stood up from the river as Shalem continued to sink below, my mind was already made.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: This is the performance I've repeated the most. I cannot refuse, nor do I want to... not until the true end comes.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Perhaps you will become a monster.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Listen, Lucian.
Lucian stays still, and does not look up.
The lady sighs, and her azure eyes light up like never before. She shakes her tails, and her body splits into two identical figures...
One walks into Lucian's shadow, while the other remains sitting before him, staring...
Both Miss.Christines speak in a staggered pattern, like a strange duet—this way she ensures Lucian will hear every word she says.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: To be honest, I much prefer 'Phantom'...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: It implies nothing good, but it is a name you came up with yourself.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Humans are so troublesome. Sometimes I miss the cafe where we met. Your emotions were much more complex and slovenly than they are now...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: But still far better than today... The bitterness of your obsession is making me want to sneeze.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Go, meet him if you must.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: If you turn into a madman, I will devour all your emotions... No matter how hard they may be to swallow.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: If you cease to exist, I will haunt him, and figure out a way to make his life miserable...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: After all, he can't do a thing to me.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Break a leg, Phantom.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Mrow~

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: Hurry... hurry! Lemme into the underground passage!

steps.name: Twitchy Staff
steps.text: Hey! Did the storm blast your eyes blind? Do you have any idea how long I've been in this queue? Why, I oughta teach you a lesson—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: No pushing or shoving, people! The passage can only fit two at a time, so don't clog up the entrance and leave space for those behind you! There's still time to get everyone in!

steps.name: Worried Staff
steps.text: Miss Stone, the plate's western paths and outer guardrails have been destroyed by the storm.

steps.name: Worried Staff
steps.text: If this keeps up, we won't be able to hold out for long even in the engine layer.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I sent people to move supplies in. If we can survive this calamity...

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: No, I'm sure we'll make it through.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Miss Rutherford, you should hurry inside! The storm will tear your dress into shreds!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: So this is the wind she felt...

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Huh? What'd you say?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Didn't you go looking for Tip to discuss the backdrop earlier? Where is she?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: She seemed to have figured something out and took off. I couldn't catch up to her.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: And we're supposed to be the adults. In the face of a Catastrophe, not one of us is as cool-headed and brave as her.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Because she doesn't know what fear is yet.

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: Only by experiencing it, hoping through it, and getting crushed by it, will she understand just how idealistic it is to keep going.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Is that not the difficulty and charm of film production itself?

steps.name: Abner
steps.text: ...Don't tell me you wanna finish shooting this damned movie even now?

steps.name: Unlucky Stagehand
steps.text: Miss Stone! The supplies are all underground now, and most of the crew too.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Thank you, Hautin. You should hurry down yourself.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Is there anything else?

steps.name: Unlucky Stagehand
steps.text: I asked around, and no one's seen the director ever since we started approaching the storm.

steps.name: Unlucky Stagehand
steps.text: A stagehand in charge of the west side told me earlier that the Catastrophe destroyed not just the guardrails, but some buildings too...

steps.name: Unlucky Stagehand
steps.text: That's where Steven's studio is!
The storm showers Originium dust all over the exquisite, dream-creating backdrops. In an instant, only the blackened skeletons of a dozen sets remain, slanted supports scattered all over the plate.
Like a cage crushed into pieces.
Lucian pays closer attention to the wind, and it brings more voices—
Shouts and sobs, scolding and cursing, sincere prayers and subconscious wailing...
The hands of fate and the play staged by nature will not allow everyone time to take their positions.
Lucian walks into the ruins—
He sees a figure that absolutely could not have showed up right here, right now.
The Catastrophe shows no respect for the dreams crafted by man, and the storm has removed Lady Dupont's manor from the scene, leaving only a grand staircase in its wake.
Thick clouds lie low, but stage lights still shine onto the steps from afar, turning the ruins into a stage...
A middle-aged man slowly walks up the stairs.
He tugs on a curtain torn apart by the storm, trying to restore its neatness and beauty. Finally, his efforts pay off as the dirt and dust fall off the cloth, revealing its original shade of red.
He grips a bottle in hand as usual, but is not at all a listless drunkard. He checks the stage right before the show begins—there is no one more dedicated to the work than him.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Your habits haven't changed... do you require assistance?

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: It's almost time, Lucian.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: You came at the perfect moment.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Not surprised?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Should I be?

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Of course you wouldn't.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: There is no way for a character who has bowed out with a real death to return to the stage.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: But this is your play, where all sorts of 'miracles' occur.

spans.text: play, where all sorts of 'miracles' occur.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: 'This is where the show begins, and where it should end as well.'

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: The Playwright might remark on how ingenuously this play has been handled.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Or perhaps he would muse on how perfect it all is.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Because once you push aside all the theatricality, this is what I look like when 'officially collaborating' with you again, after so many years apart.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: How is Abyss doing? Oh, my apologies, you are more inclined to call him Shalem, I believe?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Traveling, gathering inspiration, disaster relief... In short, he won't be showing up here.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Of course. The Crimson Troupe has long since ceased to exist, and I'm glad to see the both of you walk out from its haze.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: A new role, a new life, a new home... I see the company known as Rhodes Island has provided you many a revelation.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: But you? Why have you come here, child?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Should I not have?

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: No, no. You are our most important individual now, as the curtains are about to fall on this new play.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...I'm already on the stage, after all.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Of course, of course.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: The marvelous scene we saw at the opening of this show was all thanks to you and him.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Dalton personally handed you the weapon that would kill him, and his death raised the curtains on this story.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: And you witnessed it all through his eyes.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: Lucian, surely you felt something was off the moment you held the knife.

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: While I was relieved to confirm it...

steps.name: Dalton?
steps.text: I am also curious: why exactly did you swing that blade with zero hesitation...?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Once an actor takes the stage, anything unexpected must become a part of the performance.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Your lessons have been engraved into my mind, and nothing more—

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Troupe Leader.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Long time no see, Lucian.
